blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Continual learning (CL) is essential for Large Language Models (LLMs) to sequentially adapt to evolving tasks. To mitigate catastrophic forgetting, recent advances implement low-rank adaptation with orthogonal projections (e.g., O-LoRA) to isolate task parameters.
However, we reveal that such strict geometric constraints trigger an “Orthogonality Dilemma”: rigid parameter isolation impedes the transfer and accumulation of shared representations across semantically related tasks.
In this work, we propose a new replay-free method, called Co nsolidation and De coupling LoRA (CoDe-LoRA), for CL of LLMs. CoDe-LoRA disentangles the learning process into Consolidating Universal Knowledge and Decoupling Task-Specific Knowledge . To achieve this, CoDe-LoRA leverages an adaptive null space projection mechanism and semantic routing to balance knowledge accumulation with task-specific adaptation. Experimental results across four backbones and three CL benchmarks show that CoDe-LoRA achieves the best average accuracy. Our code is available at https://github.com/Estrellajer/CoDe-LoRA .
blocks.zh:
连续学习(CL)对于大语言模型(LLMs)依次适应不断变化的任务至关重要. 为了减轻灾难性的遗忘,最近的进展是采用正向预测(如O-LORA)进行低级调整,以隔离任务参数。
然而,我们揭示出,这种严格的几何限制触发了“正统性难题”:僵硬的参数隔离阻碍了在各种有血缘关系的任务之间转移和积累共同表述。
在这部作品中,我们提出了一种新的无重放方法,称为"相和相和相和"(CoDe-Lora),用于LLMs的CL. CoDe-LORA将学习过程分解为整合通用知识,并脱钩任务具体知识。 为了实现这一目标,CoDe-LORA利用适应性的空地投射机制和语义路径,平衡知识积累与特定任务适应. 跨越4个骨干和3个CL基准的实验结果显示CoDe-LORA达到最佳平均精度. 我们的代码可见于https://github.com/Estrellajer/CoDe-LORA.

blocks.en: 1  Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have redefined the boundaries of natural language processing, exhibiting remarkable capabilities across a wide range of tasks Wei et al. (2021) . However, adapting these models to a continuous stream of evolving tasks, known as Continual Learning (CL) De Lange et al. (2021) , remains challenging. While parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods, particularly low-rank adaptation (LoRA) Hu et al. (2021) , have significantly lowered the cost of adaptation, naively applying them to sequential tasks leads to catastrophic forgetting Li and Hoiem (2017) , where learning new tasks degrades previously acquired capabilities on earlier tasks.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)重新定义了自然语言处理的界限,展现出跨越广泛任务Wei等(2021)的显著能力. 然而,将这些模型适应不断演变的任务流,称为CL(CL)De Lange等(2021年),仍然具有挑战性. 虽然参数高效的微调(PEFT)方法,特别是低等适应(LORA)Hu等(2021),大大降低了适应成本,但天真地将其应用到相继的任务上会导致灾难性地忘记了李克用和Hoiem(2017),在那里学习新的任务会降低以前在之前的任务上获得的能力.

blocks.en: To mitigate forgetting, recent work combines PEFT with orthogonal projection strategies Saha et al. (2021) ; Wang et al. (2023a) . A representative example is O-LoRA Wang et al. (2023a) , which isolates task-specific parameters in mutually orthogonal subspaces. Although effective at reducing inter-task interference, such rigid isolation introduces a trade-off between interference mitigation and knowledge transfer. When sequential tasks share semantic structure, their optimal parameter updates should naturally overlap. Enforcing strict orthogonality removes these shared components, reducing representation reuse and weakening cross-task transfer. As illustrated in Figure 1 , this phenomenon reveals an “Orthogonality Dilemma”: the same geometric constraint that protects previous knowledge can also restrict transferable representation learning across related tasks.
blocks.zh: 为缓解遗忘,最近的工作将PEFT与正交投影策略Saha等人(2021年);Wang等人(2023年a)结合起来。 一个有代表性的例子是O-LORA Wang等 (2023a),它将任务特定参数分离出相正分空间. 这种僵硬的隔离虽然能有效减少任务间的干扰,但又在减少干扰和知识转让之间产生了取舍。 当相继任务共享语义结构时,其优化参数更新应自然地重叠. 强制严格正交可以去除这些共享组件,减少代表再用并削弱跨任务转移. 如图1所显示的,这一现象揭示出“正统性难题”:保护先前知识的同一种几何限制也可能限制跨相关任务的可转让代表学习。

blocks.en: This limitation highlights a key challenge in continual adaptation: how to preserve prior knowledge while still accumulating transferable representations across related tasks. Motivated by this tension, we investigate two questions: Q1. Why does strict orthogonality limit generalization across related tasks, and under what conditions is this limitation most severe? Q2. How can we design a parameter-efficient framework that preserves transferable representations while maintaining task-specific expertise in a replay-free setting?
blocks.zh: 这一限制凸显出在持续适应方面的一个关键挑战:如何保留先前的知识,同时在相关任务中仍然积累可转让的表述。 基于这种紧张,我们调查了两个问题:问题1. 为什么严格的正统性限制了相关任务的通俗化,而且在什么条件下这种限制最为严重? 问题2. 我们如何设计一个参数效率高的框架,既能保留可转移的表述,又能在不重复的情况下保持特定任务的专门知识?

blocks.en: How can we design a parameter-efficient framework that preserves transferable representations while maintaining task-specific expertise in a replay-free setting?

blocks.en: In this paper, we introduce Co nsolidation and De coupling LoRA ( CoDe-LoRA ), a dual-branch continual adaptation framework motivated by the orthogonality-induced transfer limitation. We provide a geometric characterization showing that strict orthogonal isolation becomes increasingly detrimental as task similarity grows.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们介绍了 " 合并 " 和 " 合并 " LoRA(CoDe-LORA),这是由正统性引起的转移限制推动的双重持续适应框架。 我们提供了几何特征,表明随着任务相似性的增长,严格正统隔离变得越来越有害。

blocks.en: CoDe-LoRA separates transferable representation consolidation from task-specific specialization through two complementary branches. Unlike strict orthogonal isolation methods that suppress overlapping representations entirely, our framework preserves transferable components while constraining interference-prone directions. Specifically, the Consolidation Branch (Co-LoRA) maintains shared transferable representations through adaptive null-space projection with dynamic scaling to stabilize long-horizon continual adaptation, as empirically verified in Appendix A.2 (Table 5 ). Meanwhile, the Decoupling Branch (De-LoRA) maintains a pool of independent LoRA experts together with a prototype-based semantic routing mechanism for robust inference without explicit task identifiers. Importantly, CoDe-LoRA operates without relying on historical data replay, avoiding additional storage overhead and privacy concerns.
blocks.zh: CoDe-LORA通过两个相辅相成的分支,将可转让代表合并与任务特定专业化分开。 与完全压制重叠表述的严格正统隔离方法不同,我们的框架保留了可转移的组件,同时制约了易被干扰的方向。 具体而言,综合处(Co-LORA)通过适应性的空地预测维持共享可转移的表示,并按附录A.2(表5)中的经验核实,动态扩大,以稳定长期持续适应。 与此同时,脱钩处(De-LORA)保留着独立的LORA专家库,并有一个基于原型的语义路由机制,在没有明确的任务识别符的情况下进行有力的推论. 重要的是,CoDe-LORA的运作不依赖历史数据的回放,避免了额外的存储间接费用和隐私问题.

blocks.en: Our main contributions are summarized as follows: • We identify and analyze the Orthogonality Dilemma in PEFT-based continual learning, showing that strict parameter isolation becomes increasingly detrimental as task similarity grows. • We propose CoDe-LoRA , a dual-branch continual adaptation framework that separates transferable representation consolidation from task-specific specialization through adaptive null-space projection and prototype-based expert decoupling. • Extensive experiments across four backbones and three continual learning benchmarks show that CoDe-LoRA achieves the best average accuracy while balancing knowledge transfer and interference mitigation.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献概述如下: 在基于PEFT的继续学习中,我们确定并分析正统性难题,表明随着任务相似性的增长,严格的参数隔离变得越来越有害。 我们提议通过适应性的空地投影和基于原型的专家脱钩,将可转让代表合并与具体任务的专门化区分开来。 • 跨越四个主干线和三个持续学习基准的广泛实验表明,CoDe-LORA在平衡知识转让和减少干扰的同时,实现了最佳平均准确性。

blocks.en: 2  Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1  Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
blocks.zh: 2.1 参数有效微调

blocks.en: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) adapts Large Language Models (LLMs) with minimal additional parameters. Early approaches such as Adapters Houlsby et al. (2019) and Prompt/Prefix Tuning Li and Liang (2021) ; Lester et al. (2021) introduced lightweight modules while freezing the backbone. LoRA Hu et al. (2021) further improves efficiency through low-rank matrices. Although effective for static tasks, sequential adaptation with PEFT methods often leads to catastrophic forgetting of earlier tasks as training proceeds.
blocks.zh: 参数-效果精通(PEFT)以最小的附加参数来适应大语言模型(LLMs). 早期的方法有:Adapers Houlsby等 (2019)和Fournal/Prefix Tuning Li和Liang等 (2021);Lester等 (2021)在冻结骨干时引入了轻量级模块. LoRA Hu等 (英语). (2021)通过低等矩阵进一步提高了效率. 虽然对静态任务有效,但采用PEFT方法的相继调整往往会随着训练的进行而导致灾难性地忘记先前的任务.

blocks.en: 2.2  Continual Fine-Tuning for LLMs
blocks.zh: 2.2 法学硕士的连续精选

blocks.en: Continual fine-tuning methods mainly rely on regularization Kirkpatrick et al. (2017) , replay Qin and Joty (2021) ; He et al. (2024) , or parameter expansion Razdaibiedina et al. (2023) . Expansion-based methods avoid interference through task-specific parameters, but their parameter cost grows with the number of tasks. Replay and regularization methods preserve prior knowledge through memory buffers or parameter constraints, yet often incur computational overhead or privacy concerns. Recently, mixture-of-experts (MoE) routing frameworks such as MoLE-CIE Wang et al. (2025) have been introduced for continual adaptation; however, they typically still rely on historical exemplar replay to prevent routing drift and maintain stable performance over long task sequences and domains.
blocks.zh: 不断的微调方法主要依靠正规化的克克帕特里克等(2017年),再出演"秦与乔蒂"(2021年; He等 (2024),或参数扩展Razdaibiedina等 (2023). 基于扩展的方法通过特定任务参数避免了干扰,但其参数成本随着任务数量而增加. 重放和规范化方法通过内存缓冲或参数限制保留了先前的知识,但往往会出现计算间接费用或隐私问题. 最近,引入了专家混合路线框架,如MOLE-CIE Wang等人(2025年);然而,他们通常仍然依赖历史实例的再玩,以防止路线漂移,并在长期任务序列和领域保持稳定的性能。

blocks.en: More recently, orthogonality-based methods such as O-LoRA Wang et al. (2023a) , CLoRA Lu et al. (2025) , and N-LoRA Yang et al. (2025b) mitigate forgetting by projecting updates into orthogonal or null subspaces. Although effective at reducing interference, strict orthogonal isolation may limit representation reuse across related tasks. In contrast, CoDe-LoRA separates shared representation consolidation from task-specific specialization, balancing knowledge transfer and interference mitigation through adaptive null-space projection without historical data replay.
blocks.zh: 最近,O-Lora Wang等人(2023年a),CLORA Lu等人(2025年),N-LORA Yang等人(2025年b)等基于矫形的方法通过将更新投射入正极或无子空间来缓解遗忘. 虽然能有效减少干扰,但严格的正交隔离可能会限制代表性在相关任务中的再利用。 相形之下,CoDe-LORA将共享代表合并与任务特定专门化区分开来,通过适应性的空地投放来平衡知识转移和干扰减缓,而无需重放历史数据.

blocks.en: 4  Methodology
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en: 4.1  Overall Framework
blocks.zh: 4.1 总框架

blocks.en: To resolve the orthogonality dilemma (Section 3.3 ), we propose CoDe-LoRA (illustrated in Figure 3 ), a dual-branch framework designed to consolidate shared representations while decoupling task-specific expertise. Built upon a frozen backbone θ base \theta_{\text{base}} , our architecture operates through two parallel pathways: the Consolidation Branch (Co-LoRA, θ shared \theta_{\text{shared}} ), which accumulates transferable representations across tasks via null space projection (Sec. 4.2 ), and the Decoupling Branch (De-LoRA), which maintains a pool of independent task-specific LoRA experts { θ spec k } k = 1 T \{\theta_{\text{spec}}^{k}\}_{k=1}^{T} that captures domain nuances without interference (Sec. 4.3 ). These components are ultimately integrated via a confidence-based fallback selection strategy (Sec. 4.4 ) to ensure robust inference.
blocks.zh: 为了解决正统性的两难处境(第3.3节),我们提出Code-LORA(在图3中提及),这是一个双重分支框架,旨在合并共同的表述,同时将具体任务的专门知识脱钩。 我们的架构建立在被冻结的主干线上\theta_{\text{base}}},通过两个平行途径运作:合并处(Co-LORA, 共用\theta_{\text{shared}}}),通过空地投放(sec 4.2)累积跨任务的可转移表示;以及脱钩处(De-LORA), 维持一个独立任务专有的LORA专家库{ spec k} k = 1 T-theta_{\text{ spec}}^{k= 1}^{T} 以无干扰地捕捉域细微差别(第4.3条)。 这些组成部分最终通过基于信心的倒置选择战略(第4.4节)进行整合,以确保有力的推论。

blocks.en: 4.2  Consolidating Shared Representations
blocks.zh: 4.2 巩固共同代表制

blocks.en: While strict parameter isolation (e.g., O-LoRA) prevents catastrophic forgetting, it often hinders the accumulation of shared representations across closely related tasks. Unlike strict orthogonal isolation methods that entirely discard overlapping update components, our consolidation branch preserves accumulated shared representations while constraining only newly introduced conflicting update directions. To achieve this objective, we propose a consolidation mechanism based on null space projection and dynamic scaling.

blocks.en: 4.4  Knowledge Integration and Fallback Selection
blocks.zh: 4.4 知识整合和后退选择

blocks.en: To produce the final prediction, we employ a confidence-based fallback selection strategy that prioritizes specialized expertise while leveraging the consolidated shared branch as a robust prior. Here, the routing confidence is defined as the maximum cosine similarity between the input embedding and task prototypes. If the routing confidence exceeds a threshold τ \tau (a hyperparameter set to 0.75 0.75 by default), the system routes inference to the task-specific expert θ spec k ∗ \theta_{\text{spec}}^{k^{*}} , executing y ^ = Model ​ ( x , θ base , θ spec k ∗ ) \hat{y}=\text{Model}(x;\theta_{\text{base}},\theta_{\text{spec}}^{k^{*}}) . Otherwise, the model falls back to the consolidated shared branch, executing y ^ = Model ​ ( x , θ base , θ shared ) \hat{y}=\text{Model}(x;\theta_{\text{base}},\theta_{\text{shared}}) . A higher τ \tau trusts the router only on clear matches and sends the rest to the shared branch, whereas τ = 0 \tau=0 always trusts the routed expert. This fallback strategy dynamically balances stability and plasticity by preserving high-capacity specialized expertise while utilizing the consolidated branch as a robust safety net for ambiguous or out-of-distribution inputs. For classification tasks, candidate-label scores are additionally PMI-calibrated. The complete training and consolidation workflow is detailed in Appendix A.3 . Both branches share the same frozen backbone, so no backbone parameters are updated.

blocks.en: 5.2  Main Results
blocks.zh: 5.2 主要成果

blocks.en: On the Standard CL Benchmark (Table 1 ), CoDe-LoRA achieves the highest average accuracy (80.4%), outperforming prior PEFT-based CL methods and exceeding the MTL reference (80.0%). This result suggests that the decoupled expert pool provides task-specific capacity while avoiding the forgetting typical of sequential fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 根据标准CL基准(表1),CoDe-LORA达到最高平均精度(80.4%),优于以往基于PEFT的CL方法,并超过了MTL参考(80.0%). 这一结果表明,脱钩的专家人才库提供与任务具体有关的能力,同时避免忘记顺序微调的典型做法。

blocks.en: On the Large Number of Tasks benchmark, the performance gap is more pronounced: CoDe-LoRA achieves 79.1% average accuracy, outperforming the strongest baseline, N-LoRA, by 6.7 points (79.1% vs. 72.4%). While O-LoRA reduces interference through strict orthogonal isolation, its performance degrades on longer sequences where transferable representations become increasingly important. These results indicate stronger scalability in long-horizon scenarios.
blocks.zh: 在"任务大数"基准上,性能差距更明显:CoDe-LORA实现 79.1%的平均精度,比最强的基准N-LORA高6.7分(79.1%对72.4%)。 虽然O-LORA通过严格的正交隔离来减少干扰,但其性能却在较长的序列上下降,而可转移的表示越来越重要。 这些结果表明,在长视情景中,可扩展性更强。

blocks.en: We further evaluate CoDe-LoRA on the TRACE benchmark Wang et al. (2023b) , which contains generative tasks. As shown in Table 2 , CoDe-LoRA achieves competitive generation quality (OP) and consistently improves knowledge retention (BWT) without relying on replay buffers, indicating improved retention in generative domains.

blocks.en: To evaluate generalization across model architectures and scales, we evaluate CoDe-LoRA on Qwen3-0.6B, Qwen3.5-4B, and Llama 2-7B against isolation-based PEFT (O-LoRA, N-LoRA) and routing-based MoE (MoLE-CIE Wang et al. (2025) ) baselines (Table 2 ). CoDe-LoRA outperforms every baseline on every backbone and benchmark. On Qwen3-0.6B it improves over the strongest baseline by 9.0 points on standard CL (79.7 vs. 70.7) and by 3.7 points on the long-sequence benchmark (73.0 vs. 69.3); the corresponding margins are 3.8 and 3.8 on Llama 2-7B and 1.4 and 1.8 on Qwen3.5-4B, and TRACE OP improves by 3.2 to 8.8 points. Because every task retains its own frozen expert, both De-LoRA and CoDe-LoRA show no measurable backward transfer loss on TRACE (BWT = 0.0 =0.0 on all three backbones), whereas the strongest baseline per backbone still loses between 1.3 and 4.3 points, and MoLE-CIE loses up to 17.8. The single-branch ablations locate the gain: Co-LoRA alone is the weakest of the three, De-LoRA already accounts for most of the accuracy, and adding the consolidation branch adds a further 0.4 to 2.8 points on Std. CL and Long Seq. On TRACE, where the two branches cannot be combined, CoDe-LoRA matches De-LoRA. All of this is achieved without maintaining historical replay buffers.

blocks.en: 5.3  Ablation Studies and Analysis
blocks.zh: 5.3 研究与分析

blocks.en: We re-train O-LoRA and N-LoRA with r = 10 r=10 on T5-Large so that their per-task adapter footprint matches CoDe-LoRA at r = 8 r=8 , keeping every other setting identical (three task orders, three seeds each). Raising the baseline rank changes little: O-LoRA moves from 76.5 to 76.4 on the Standard CL Benchmark and from 70.2 to 70.4 on the Long Sequence Benchmark, and N-LoRA does not improve either. Against the strongest capacity-matched baseline, CoDe-LoRA leads by 4.0 points (80.4 vs. 76.4) and by 8.7 points (79.1 vs. 70.4), respectively. The gains therefore stem from decoupled knowledge consolidation rather than from parameter capacity.
blocks.zh: 我们用 r = 10 r = 10 在 T5-Large 上重新训练 O-LORA 和 N-LORA 使其每任务适配脚印与 CoDe-LORA = 8 r = 8 相匹配,保持所有其他设置相同(三个任务订单,每个种子三个). 提高基线级别变化不大:O-LORA从标准CL基准的76.5级提高到76.4级,从70.2级提高到70.4级;N-LORA也没有改进。 根据能力最强的基准,CoDe-LORA分别领先4.0分(80.4对76.4)和8.7分(79.1对70.4). 因此,收益来自脱钩的知识整合,而不是参数能力。

blocks.en: We compare CoDe-LoRA with LoRAHub Huang et al. (2023) , which directly merges task-specific LoRA modules. As shown in Figure 5 , LoRAHub exhibits severe catastrophic forgetting, yielding a BWT of -20.2% compared to -0.2% for CoDe-LoRA. This suggests that direct parameter merging introduces significantly stronger cross-task interference.
blocks.zh: 我们把CoDe-Lora与LoraHub Huang等人(2023年)进行比较,后者直接合并了任务特定的LORA模块. 如图5所示,LORAHUB显示出严重的灾难性遗忘,其BWT为-20.2%,而CoDe-LORA为-0.2%。 这表明直接参数合并引入了显著更强大的跨任务干扰.

blocks.en: Figure 6 shows the zero-shot forward transfer matrix on Qwen3-0.6B (Order 1). CoDe-LoRA achieves consistently higher forward transfer than O-LoRA, particularly after progressively accumulating knowledge across tasks (e.g., +19.1 points on Yahoo after training on dbpedia and amazon). This suggests that the consolidation branch effectively accumulates transferable representations that benefit future unseen tasks.
blocks.zh: 图6显示的是Qwen3-0.6B(命令1)上的零发前向转移矩阵. CoDe-LORA实现的远期转移始终高于O-LORA,特别是在跨任务逐渐积累知识之后(例如,在Dbpedia和Amazon培训之后,Yahoo的分数为+19.1)。 这表明合并分支机构有效地积累了可转移的表示,有利于未来无形的任务。

blocks.en: We analyze the sensitivity of routing performance to the number of prototype samples N N . Figure 5 (right) shows that routing accuracy improves as N N increases, with performance saturating around N = 10 N=10 . This indicates that only a small number of samples are required for reliable task routing.

blocks.en: CoDe-LoRA trains one adapter per task on top of the consolidated branch, so a task costs as much as for O-LoRA and N-LoRA (98.4 s vs. 108.8 s and 98.0 s on the Standard benchmark, 50.1 s vs. 53.2 s and 47.9 s on the Long benchmark) and about 9 × 9\times less than MoLE-CIE (Table 3 ). It stores only the experts, the same 9.4M adapter parameters as O-LoRA and N-LoRA on four tasks (1.28% of the backbone, and 35.4M or 4.80% on the fifteen tasks of the Long benchmark; Appendix Table 11 ); the consolidated branch and the per-task contexts are rebuilt by replaying the folds. The price is inference: replaying the context of the routed expert makes an evaluation pass about 1.4 × 1.4\times slower than O-LoRA (43.1 s vs. 30.1 s).

blocks.en: 6  Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We revisit orthogonal continual adaptation from the perspective of transferable representation learning. We show that while strict orthogonal isolation mitigates catastrophic forgetting, it can also suppress transferable representation accumulation across related tasks. To address this limitation, we propose CoDe-LoRA, a dual-branch continual adaptation framework that balances shared representation consolidation and task-specific adaptation. Extensive experiments demonstrate strong continual learning performance together with robust forward and backward transfer across diverse task sequences and model families.
blocks.zh: 我们从可转移的代表性学习的角度重新审视正统的持续适应。 我们表明,虽然严格的正统隔离可减轻灾难性的遗忘,但也可抑制相关任务的可转移代表性积累。 为了克服这一局限性,我们提议建立CoDe-LORA,这是一个双重分支的持续适应框架,兼顾共同的代表性整合和针对具体任务的适应。 广泛的实验表明,不断学习的成绩强劲,同时在各种任务序列和模范家庭之间进行有力的前向和后向转移。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Although CoDe-LoRA demonstrates strong performance across both classification and generative continual learning benchmarks, our evaluation is limited to pre-trained language models. Extending the framework to multi-modal continual learning settings remains an important direction for future work. In addition, the effectiveness of the routing mechanism depends on the quality of task prototypes in the embedding space. Under severe task distribution shifts or highly overlapping task boundaries, routing reliability may degrade and require more adaptive prototype estimation strategies.
blocks.zh: 虽然CoDe-LORA在分类和遗传性持续学习基准方面都表现出强劲的表现,但我们的评价仅限于预先培训的语言模型。 将框架扩大到多模式的持续学习环境仍然是今后工作的一个重要方向。 此外,路由机制的有效性取决于嵌入空间中任务原型的质量. 在任务分配发生严重转变或任务界线高度重叠的情况下,路线可靠性可能降低,需要更适应性强的原型估计战略。

blocks.en: One might be concerned that the s t = 1 / t s_{t}=1/\sqrt{t} scaling in Eq. ( 4 ) dilutes the historical knowledge in the shared memory. We argue that this scaling acts as a variance normalization mechanism rather than information loss. Without scaling, the norm of the shared branch would grow linearly with t \sqrt{t} (assuming orthogonal updates), eventually overwhelming the task-specific branch. The s t = 1 / t s_{t}=1/\sqrt{t} factor ensures that the shared memory remains a stable “anchor” while the specific branch (Section 4.3 ) preserves the distinct decision boundaries for each task. This dual-branch design effectively decouples stability (via normalized shared memory) from plasticity (via preserved specific experts).

blocks.en: Following existing CL works Qin and Joty (2021) ; Wang et al. (2023a) ; Yang et al. (2025b) , all methods are implemented with instruction tuning Qin and Joty (2021) and optimized with AdamW Loshchilov and Hutter (2017) ( β = ( 0.9 , 0.999 ) \beta=(0.9,0.999) , no weight decay, gradient clipping at 1.0) under a constant learning rate, in bfloat16. Every method trains each task for one epoch with an effective batch size of 64, and inputs are truncated to 512 source and 50 target tokens. The learning rate is set per backbone: 10 − 3 10^{-3} for T5-large, and 10 − 4 10^{-4} for Llama 2-7B and Qwen3.5-4B. On Qwen3-0.6B the per-task-expert methods (De-LoRA, CoDe-LoRA) use 10 − 3 10^{-3} , while the methods built on a single shared adapter use 10 − 4 10^{-4} . For all LoRA-based architectures we set rank r = 8 r=8 , α = 32 \alpha=32 and dropout 0.1 0.1 , targeting the query and value projections of every Transformer block. Routing uses an LDA classifier on frozen-backbone embeddings estimated from 1000 support samples per task (Appendix A.5 ), the consolidation uses a randomized low-rank SVD with retained rank 8 8 , and classification tasks are scored over their candidate labels with PMI calibration while TRACE is evaluated by generation.

At 10 − 4 10^{-4} the per-task experts of De-LoRA and CoDe-LoRA cannot learn the smallest tasks (CB and COPA, 4–6 optimizer steps per epoch) on Qwen3-0.6B, and De-LoRA falls from 71.2 to 59.5.

blocks.en: To resolve the computational bottleneck of null space projection in large-scale LLMs, we adopt an optimized consolidation strategy. Specifically, we replace full Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) with a randomized low-rank SVD ( torch.svd_lowrank ) to efficiently extract singular vectors U U from the column space of consolidated parameters. To further reduce complexity, the projection is performed directly on the low-rank factor B ∈ ℝ d o ​ u ​ t × r B\in\mathbb{R}^{d_{out}\times r} rather than the full update Δ ​ W ∈ ℝ d o ​ u ​ t × d i ​ n \Delta W\in\mathbb{R}^{d_{out}\times d_{in}} . The orthogonalized factor is computed as B orth = B − U ⁡ ( U ⊤ ​ B ) B_{\text{orth}}=B-U(U^{\top}B) , and the resulting update is Δ ​ W null = B orth ​ A \Delta W_{\text{null}}=B_{\text{orth}}A . This optimization reduces the projection matrix dimensions from d o ​ u ​ t × d i ​ n d_{out}\times d_{in} to d o ​ u ​ t × r d_{out}\times r , where r ≪ d i ​ n r\ll d_{in} , achieving significant speedup while preserving mathematical accuracy. In practice, we set the number of randomized SVD iterations ( svd_niter ) to 1 to balance precision and performance.

blocks.en: As introduced in Section 4.2 , standard SVD on the full weight matrix update Δ ​ W ∈ ℝ d o ​ u ​ t × d i ​ n \Delta W\in\mathbb{R}^{d_{out}\times d_{in}} requires 𝒪 ⁡ ( d o ​ u ​ t ​ d i ​ n ​ min ⁡ ( d o ​ u ​ t , d i ​ n ) ) \mathcal{O}(d_{out}d_{in}\min(d_{out},d_{in})) operations, which is prohibitively expensive for large language models where d o ​ u ​ t , d i ​ n d_{out},d_{in} can scale to thousands or tens of thousands. In contrast, by projecting directly on the low-rank factor B ∈ ℝ d o ​ u ​ t × r B\in\mathbb{R}^{d_{out}\times r} and leveraging the randomized low-rank SVD method ( torch.svd_lowrank ), the computational complexity is reduced to 𝒪 ⁡ ( d o ​ u ​ t ​ r 2 ) \mathcal{O}(d_{out}r^{2}) where r r is the LoRA rank (typically r ∈ [ 8 , 32 ] r\in[8,32] ). Because r ≪ d i ​ n , d o ​ u ​ t r\ll d_{in},d_{out} , this optimization achieves a speedup of several orders of magnitude. In practice, the SVD consolidation is negligible: over a whole T5-large run it takes 0.7 s for the four tasks of the Standard benchmark and 4.1 s for the fifteen tasks of the Long benchmark, while preserving the mathematical guarantee of null space projection. This provides a direct, highly efficient bridge between the theoretical null space projection in Section 4.2 and the practical scalability of our framework.

blocks.en:
While randomized SVD inevitably introduces approximation noise, CoDe-LoRA remains theoretically and architecturally robust to this relaxation. Theoretically, our dynamic scaling factor dampens noise accumulation, bounding the approximation error. Architecturally, the Decoupling Branch serves as a safety net; if approximation noise compromises the shared branch, routing dynamically isolates predictions to task-specific experts.
To verify this, we vary the SVD retained rank on the Order-1 benchmark (T5-large, three seeds). Table 6 reports the accuracy of the consolidation branch alone and of the full model.
blocks.zh:
虽然随机化的SVD不可避免地引入了近似噪声,而CoDe-LORA在理论上和建筑上对于这种放松仍然很坚固. 理论上,我们的动态缩放因子 抑制了噪音的积累, 约束了近似误差。 从结构上讲,脱钩分会是一个安全网;如果近似噪声损害到共享分会,则动态地将预测隔离给任务特定专家.
为了验证这一点,我们更改了秩序-1基准(T5-大,三种子)上SVD保留等级. 表6仅报告合并处和完整模型的准确性。

blocks.en: The consolidation branch alone improves monotonically with the retained rank, since a lower rank discards more of the accumulated update. The full model does not move because the routed expert answers every input, so the shared branch does not enter the prediction. The retained rank therefore matters for the quality of the consolidated weights, not for the routed accuracy.

blocks.en: During the learning of each sequential task 𝒯 t \mathcal{T}_{t} , CoDe-LoRA decouples and consolidates knowledge through a structured step-by-step procedure: 1. Initialization: The Consolidation Branch parameters θ shared \theta_{\text{shared}} are initialized from the previously consolidated state W acc ( t − 1 ) W_{\text{acc}}^{(t-1)} to enable immediate knowledge reuse and positive transfer, while a new task-specific expert θ spec ( t ) \theta_{\text{spec}}^{(t)} is initialized to zero. 2. Joint Training: Both branches are optimized jointly on the current task dataset 𝒟 ( t ) \mathcal{D}^{(t)} using instruction tuning. This joint optimization allows the Consolidation Branch to assimilate shared representation updates while the Decoupling Branch captures task-specific nuances. 3. Null Space Consolidation: Post-training, the parameter update learned in the Consolidation Branch, denoted as Δ ​ W shared ( t ) = W shared ( t ) − W acc ( t − 1 ) \Delta W_{\text{shared}}^{(t)}=W_{\text{shared}}^{(t)}-W_{\text{acc}}^{(t-1)} , is extracted. We project this update onto the null space of the accumulated representation history W acc ( t − 1 ) W_{\text{acc}}^{(t-1)} using randomized low-rank SVD (as detailed above) to eliminate representational interference. 4. blocks.en: A.4  Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: A.4 评价计量

blocks.en: We evaluate sequential learning performance using two standard metrics in continual learning:
blocks.zh: 我们利用两个持续学习的标准衡量标准来评价连续学习的业绩:

blocks.en: represents the overall model capacity across all learned tasks after completing the continual learning sequence. For a sequence of T T tasks, it is defined as: AP = 1 T ​ ∑ i = 1 T a i , T \text{AP}=\frac{1}{T}\sum_{i=1}^{T}a_{i,T} (15) where a i , T a_{i,T} denotes the evaluation performance (accuracy for classification benchmarks, or task-specific generative metrics like ROUGE/Exact Match for generative benchmarks) on task i i after training on the final task T T . In classification benchmarks, this corresponds to the standard Average Accuracy ( A T A_{T} ), while in generative benchmarks (such as TRACE), it is referred to as Overall Performance (OP).
blocks.zh: 代表完成持续学习序列后所有学习任务的总体模型能力。 对于一系列的T T任务,定义为:AP=1 T i=1 T a i,T\text{AP}=\frac{1}{T}\sum_{i=1}^{T}a_{i,T}(15),其中i,t a_{i,T}表示对任务i的评价性能(分类基准的准确性,或任务特定分基因指标,如ROUGE/基因基准的精确匹配性),经过关于最终任务T的训练后. 在分类基准中,这与标准平均精确度(A T AQQT})相对应,而在基因基准(如TRACE)中,它被称为"总体性能"(OP).

blocks.en: Lopez-Paz and Ranzato (2017) measures the influence of learning subsequent tasks on the performance of previously acquired knowledge: BWT = 1 T − 1 ​ ∑ i = 1 T − 1 ( a i , T − a i , i ) \text{BWT}=\frac{1}{T-1}\sum_{i=1}^{T-1}(a_{i,T}-a_{i,i}) (16) where a i , i a_{i,i} is the performance on task i i immediately after training on task i i . A negative BWT value indicates catastrophic forgetting (performance degradation), whereas a value closer to 0 or positive indicates stable knowledge retention or positive backward transfer (where learning new tasks improves performance on older tasks). By employing BWT as our unified metric for backward retention across all benchmarks, we avoid the redundancy of using separate forgetting indicators for classification and generative tasks.

BWT负值表示灾难性的遗忘(性能退化),而接近0或正值表示稳定的知识保留或正后向转移(其中学习新任务能改善老任务的业绩)。 通过使用BWT作为我们在所有基准中落后留存的统一衡量标准,我们避免了重复使用单独的遗忘指标进行分类和基因分配。

blocks.en: measures the zero-shot accuracy on a task that has not been trained yet. After learning the first k k tasks, FWT k → j = a j , k \text{FWT}_{k\to j}=a_{j,k} for j > k j>k , which we compare with the accuracy of the untrained backbone and of the other methods on the same task.

blocks.en: A.5  Router Choice
blocks.zh: A.5 路由器选择

blocks.en: The main experiments route with a linear discriminant analysis (LDA) classifier on frozen-backbone sentence embeddings. For every task we store the mean embedding and one covariance matrix shared by all tasks, estimated from 1000 support samples per task, and an input goes to the task with the largest discriminant score. No raw sample is stored, so the method stays replay-free and the per-task storage is one vector, as for a prototype, plus a single shared matrix. The cosine prototype router of Section 4.3 is also implemented.
blocks.zh: 由被冷冻后骨句嵌入的线性歧义分析(LDA)分级器所构成的主要实验路线. 对于每一项任务,我们都存储着所有任务共享的平均嵌入和一个共变矩阵,估计每个任务有1000个支持样本,投入到任务上,得到的最大歧视分. 没有原始样本被存储,因此方法保持了回放自由,每任务存储为一向量,如原型,外加一个共享矩阵. 第4.3节的余弦原型路由器也得到实施.

blocks.zh: 表7:T5(三种种子)的跑道出错及其成本。 损失是真任务专家的AP减去路由专家的AP.

blocks.en: The cosine router fails by confusing tasks of the same family, because it compares only the direction of the mean embedding and ignores the within-task variance. On Order 4 the largest confusions are MNLI → \to RTE (22.7% of MNLI inputs), MNLI → \to CB (13.0%), Yahoo → \to QQP (6.9%), Yelp → \to Amazon (5.1%) and Amazon → \to IMDB (4.0%). LDA whitens with the shared within-task covariance and removes most of these errors. Figure 7 varies the number of support samples per task: cosine routing with N = 10 N=10 is still below its plateau and does not close the gap to LDA on the Long benchmark, and mean-centering the embeddings helps on the Standard benchmark but hurts on the Long benchmark. On the Long benchmark LDA already reaches 94.2% routing accuracy with N = 10 N=10 , while the cosine router with N = 100 N=100 reaches 93.3%; LDA saturates beyond about 500 samples per task.
blocks.zh: 余弦路由器由于混淆了同家族的任务而失败,因为它只比较了平均嵌入的方向并忽略了任务内的差异. 根据4号命令,最大的混乱是MNLI ~\至RTE(占MNLI输入量的22.7%)、MNLI →\至CB(13.0%)、Yahoo →\至QQP(6.9%)、Yelp →\至Amazon(5.1%)和Amazon →\至IMDB(4.0%)。 LDA白子与共享的任务内共变并去除大多数这些错误. 图7对每个任务的支持样本数量有不同:有N=10 N=10的余弦径向仍然低于其高地,没有在长基准上弥补与LDA的差距,而嵌入中枢有助于在标准基准上,但在长基准上伤害. 在长基准LDA上已经达到94.2%的路由精度,以N=10N=10;而有N=100N=100的同位素路由器则达到93.3%;LDA饱和度超过约500个每个任务样本.

blocks.en: A.6  Co/De Synergy: Attempts and Limits
blocks.zh: A.6 协同/协同:尝试和限制

blocks.en: We summarise what we tried to make the consolidation branch (Co) improve on the routed expert (De). All numbers are T5-large, three seeds, AP on the Standard (Order 1) and Long (Order 4) benchmarks, reported as Std / Long; rules are selected on a development subset and reported on test.
blocks.zh: 我们总结了我们试图使合并处(Co)改善路由专家(De)的情况。 所有编号为T5大号,有3个种子,AP在标准上(第1号命令)和长号(第4号命令)基准上,被报告为Std / Long;规则在一个开发子集上被选定并被报告测试.

blocks.en: Taking the better of Co and the routed expert per example (the oracle) exceeds the routed expert by 4.7 (Std) to 9.5 (Long) points (Table 9 , Figure 8 ). The oracle is a diagnostic of how many examples Co answers correctly while the expert fails, not an attainable bound. Yet no rule chosen on development data captures it. With the LDA router the posterior is almost always above any useful threshold, so Co answers at most 0.3% of the inputs and CoDe-LoRA reduces to De-LoRA. With the cosine router the fallback does fire, but the routing itself first loses 4.7 points on the Long benchmark, more than Co recovers. The thresholds chosen on development data degenerate to “never use Co”.
blocks.zh: 取Co的好和路由专家的每个例子(甲骨文)比路由专家多出4.7(Std)到9.5(长)分(表9,图8)。 甲骨文是对多少例子的诊断 当专家失败时,共同正确回答,而不是可实现的约束。 然而,在开发数据方面没有选择规则。 由于LDA路由器,后置器几乎总是高于任何有用的阈值,因此Co最多回答0.3%的输入而CoDe-LORA被降为De-LORA. 使用余弦路由器后倒回会起火,但路由本身首先在"长生"基准上损失了4.7分,比"Co"恢复还多. 在开发数据上选择的阈值已退化为“从未使用过公司”。

blocks.en: Figure 8 : Per-task accuracy of Co, the routed expert and their oracle on the Long benchmark (Order 4).
blocks.zh: 图8:Co、路由专家及其长效基准上的甲骨文的每个任务精度(第4号命令)。

blocks.en: We replayed twelve rounds of schemes on the same checkpoints, the same development subset and the same selection protocol (Table 8 ). Confidence-threshold fallbacks, per-expert gating, output selectors and a 1480-feature selector produced no development-qualified rule or gains below one point that did not hold across protocols. Fusing the two branches on candidate-label scores with a per-task weight was the only scheme that was positive across backbones, and it is the one used in the main tables. Without calibration, summing the two branches hurts on the Long benchmark ( − 1.0 -1.0 to − 1.6 -1.6 ) because the label prior of Co is not removed.
blocks.zh: 我们在同一检查站、同一发展子集和同样的选择协议上重放12轮计划(表8)。 置信阈值倒计时、按专家计分、产出选择器和1480个地物选择器没有产生任何发展合格规则或收益,低于某一点,而这种规则或收益没有跨越协议。 将两个分支放在候选人标签上的分数上,加上每个任务加权数,是整个主干部门中唯一积极的方案,也是主要表格中使用的方案。 不进行校正,将两个分支相接会伤害到长基准上(−1.0-1.0到−1.6-1.6),因为Co之前的标签没有被去掉.

blocks.zh: 表8:合并的推断时间计划 与路由专家。

blocks.en: Mixing the log-probabilities of Co and the routed expert at every decoding step, ( 1 − w ) ​ log ⁡ p De + w ​ log ⁡ p Co (1-w)\log p_{\text{De}}+w\log p_{\text{Co}} , does not help either. The weight chosen on development data is w = 0 w=0 on both benchmarks; a per-task weight gives + 0.13 +0.13 (Std) and + 0.44 +0.44 (Long), 2.8% and 5.2% of the oracle gap, at 2.0–2.25 × \times the decoding cost. The branches agree on the top-1 token in 95% (Std) and 91% (Long) of the steps, with log-probability correlations of 0.94 and 0.92, so a mixture with w = 0.3 w=0.3 changes the argmax in only 1.4–1.6% of the steps, and the gains and losses cancel. The complementarity exists at the example level but not at the token level.

blocks.en: Table 9 changes only how Co is merged. Projecting against the historical factor space, on one or both sides, or distilling after the SVD, does not improve Co. Merging experts that were trained in isolation from the base model into Co fails, because that shared block is never trained and the generation format collapses (41.87 / 11.06). The null-space merge of Section 4.2 gives a weaker Co that is the most complementary to the experts (oracle 84.53 / 86.00).

blocks.zh: 表9:共同建筑(基因测试): 独行侠和神谕 取胜于Co和路由专家 仅路由专家就得分79.13 / 76.3–76.5 (Std / Long).

blocks.en: Initialising each new expert from Co, either by transferring the update or its input subspace, did not pass the development gate across both benchmarks. A family-level initialisation gives + 2.30 ± 0.31 +2.30\pm 0.31 on the Long benchmark (positive in 18 of 18 runs over two independent seed sets), but 93% of it comes from the single task CB ( + 34.1 +34.1 ); without CB and COPA it falls to + 0.08 +0.08 , and it is no better than a global Co initialisation ( + 0.03 +0.03 ). We therefore report it as a local effect.
blocks.zh: 从 Co通过转移更新或其输入子空间,没有通过跨越两个基准的开发门. 家族层面的初始化在长基准上给出了+ 2.30 ± 0.31 + 2.30\pm 0.31(正值为18分之18跑出两套独立种子),但其中93%来自单项任务 CB(+ 34.1+34.1);没有 CB 和 COPA 则降为 + 0.08 + 0.08,不比全局更好. 共同初始化(+0.03+0.03). 因此,我们把它报告为地方效应。

blocks.en: With the cosine router (89.9% accurate), fusing paper-style Co with the experts improves over the same calibrated single-branch baseline by + 0.49 +0.49 (Std, 3/3 seeds) and + 1.60 +1.60 (Long, 3/3). Replacing the router by LDA (98.8% accurate) with Co unchanged reduces these to + 0.13 +0.13 (Std, 2/3) and + 0.77 +0.77 (Long, 3/3): about half of the apparent gain was the fusion repairing routing errors, not new information from Co, and 94% of the rest comes from CB and COPA (26 and 40 development examples). When evaluating a two-branch fusion, the routing quality must be fixed and a calibrated single-branch baseline must be reported.
blocks.zh: 与余弦路由器(89.9%准确)相接,引信纸型 与专家共同改进了同一校准的单分支基线,增加了+0.49+0.49(标准,3/3种子)和+1.60+1.60(长,3/3). 用LDA(98.8%准确)来替换路由器,Co不变,将路由器降低为+0.13+0.13(Std,2/3)和+0.77+0.77(Long,3/3):约一半的明显收益是聚变修复路由错误,而不是来自Co的新信息,其余94%来自CB和COPA(26和40个开发实例). 在评价两支管聚变时,必须固定路由质量并报告校准的单支管基线.

blocks.en: A.8  Datasets
blocks.zh: A.8 数据集

blocks.en: Table 12 : Datasets and their tasks, categories, domains, and metrics.
blocks.zh: 表12:数据集及其任务、类别、域和衡量标准。

blocks.en: In our experiments, we utilize 15 datasets from standard classification and NLU benchmarks (as detailed in Table 12 ), as well as the generation-heavy TRACE benchmark Wang et al. (2023b) . Specifically, the classification datasets are sourced from well-established suites such as the CL benchmark Zhang et al. (2015) , GLUE Wang et al. (2018) , and SuperGLUE Wang et al. (2019) , as well as the IMDB movie review dataset Maas et al. (2011) . These cover natural language inference (NLI), sentiment classification (SC), and topic classification (TC).
blocks.zh: 在我们的实验中,我们利用了来自标准分类和NLU基准(详见表12)的15个数据集,以及发电重的TRACE基准Wang等(2023年b). 具体地说,分类数据集来源于CL基准张等(2015年),GLUE Wang等(2018年),SuperGLUE Wang等(2019年),以及IMDB电影评论数据集Maas等(2011年). 其中包括自然语言推论(NLI)、情绪分类(SC)和主题分类(TC)。

blocks.en: Crucially, to evaluate generalization on more complex, generation-heavy tasks, we also incorporate the TRACE benchmark Wang et al. (2023b) . Unlike standard classification tasks, TRACE features multi-turn, complex generative tasks that assess the structural reasoning and domain adaptation of LLMs. In particular, we evaluate on code generation (completion) using the Py150 dataset, where even a single syntax error can lead to a compilation failure, making it highly fragile under sequential fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 关键是,为了评价更复杂、更重的一代任务的总体情况,我们还纳入了TRACE基准Wang等(2023b)。 与标准分类任务不同的是,TRACE具有多回转,复杂的基因任务,可以评估LLMs的结构推理和域适应性. 特别是,我们利用Py150数据集对代码生成(完成)进行评价,即使一个单一的语法错误也会导致编译失败,使其在相继的微调下非常脆弱.
